crossRefs.note: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

translations.web: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
translations.bsb: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
translations.kjv: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
translations.asv: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from the bloodthirsty men.
